disclaimer: APPROXIMATE. Uruguay's IRPF brackets are officially set in BPC (Base de Prestaciones y Contribuciones) units, which are indexed and change periodically — the UYU thresholds below are estimated from a 2024 BPC value and should be verified against DGI's current published brackets before relying on this. Uruguay is largely territorial for foreign-source income under its tax-holiday regime for new residents, which this calculator does not model. Social security (BPS) contributions and family-unit joint filing are not included.

regimes.label: Resident (IRPF)
regimes.notes: APPROXIMATE thresholds converted from BPC-indexed brackets. Employment/personal-services income only; capital income is taxed separately at a flat 12% under IRPF, not modeled here.

regimes.label: Non-Resident (IRNR)
regimes.notes: Non-Resident Income Tax (IRNR) on Uruguayan-sourced employment/personal-services income, taken as a flat 12%. IRNR rates for other income types range 3%-25% and are not modeled here.

residency_threshold_note: ADVISORY ONLY, not a legal determination: 183+ days physically present in a tax year is commonly used as a resident-status guideline. Actual rules vary by country (tie-breaker tests, visa type, permanent home, center of vital interests, etc.) and this figure does not override your own judgment or professional advice.
